sum: Lakshmi Niwas Bangur has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Takeover Regulations regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in The Peria Karamalai Tea & Produce Company Limited. detail: Lakshmi Niwas Bangur submitted a formal disclosure to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, in respect of The Peria Karamalai Tea & Produce Company Limited. The disclosure mechanism requires persons acquiring 5% or more of voting capital, or subsequent acquisitions of 2% or more (if already holding 5%+), to file within two trading days. The identity of Bangur as a natural person and the choice of NSE as the filing exchange suggest the target is NSE-listed. No open offer announcement or competing bid information has emerged, indicating either a strategic acquisition below open offer thresholds or an ongoing accumulation by an existing promoter-linked entity.
